t: Trump’s Putin Ties Draw Focus After Summit
s: Bloomberg Economics Analyst Alex Kokcharov discusses President Donald Trump’s historic meeting with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping on Bloomberg This Weekend with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini. The summit produced limited concrete results despite a joint declaration on energy and nuclear risks. Kokcharov examines the implications of Trump’s relationship with Putin for Ukraine as European nations assume more of Kyiv’s support amid an intensifying war following an attack on the Crimean Bridge.
